headline: Extended the memorandum of understanding with Mt. Tom Generating Co., LLC on the former Mt. Tom Power Plant site.
summary: Engie North America representatives discussed possible future paths for the former Mt. Tom Power Plant property, including a sale or ways to lower site costs. Staff is also exploring whether remaining grant funds could pay for work at the former Gas Works property near the Holyoke Dam.
decisions: Extended the memorandum of understanding with Mt. Tom Generating Co., LLC with no set expiration date, 5-0.
Tabled the minutes of June 25, 2026 because there was no quorum at that meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made by Carl Eger and seconded by Michale Sullivan to extend the MOU with Mt.Tom Generating Co., LLC. as stated, and with the same terms as already agreed to. A roll call followed:
The meeting minutes of June 25, 2026 were tabled due to a lack of a quorum of members present at that meeting.

decision_titles: Memorandum of Understanding with Mt. Tom Generating Co., LLC
